## Process and merge input dataset

```{r}
length(unique(raw_data_ls$summary$Paper_id))
```

```{r}
nrow(raw_data_ls$summary)
```

```{r}
nrow(raw_data_ls$extended)
```

```{r}
processed_tb <- raw_data_ls$summary %>%
  dplyr::left_join(raw_data_ls$extended %>%
                     dplyr::rename(Comparator_Ext = Comparator) %>%
                     dplyr::select(c("paper_id", "Comparator_Ext", "Population extract",
                                     "Diagnosis", "Setting", "Setting_Category",
                                     "Results", "No. intervention evaluated")) %>%
                     dplyr::rename(Paper_id = "paper_id"))

```

```{r}
processed_tb <- processed_tb %>%
  dplyr::filter(Quality == "H")
```

```{r}
nrow(processed_tb)
```
```{r}
processed_tb <- processed_tb %>%
    transform_to_filtered_patterns(col = `Evaluation methods`,
                                   allowable_patterns_chr = "CUA")
```

```{r}
nrow(processed_tb)
```


```{r}
processed_tb <- processed_tb %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    CE_Results_Raw = `Cost-effectiveness outcomes (in 2024 AUD)`
  )
```

```{r}
processed_tb <- processed_tb %>%

  transform_to_expand_numbered_items(

    source_col =
      `Cost-effectiveness outcomes (in 2024 AUD)`,

    item_nbr_col =
      "CE_Item_Nbr",

    item_seq_col =
      "CE_Item_Seq",

    item_text_col =
      "CE_Item_Text",

    pre_item_text_col =
      "CE_Pre_Item_Text",

    post_item_text_col =
      "CE_Post_Item_Text",

    original_text_col =
      "CE_Raw"

  )
```


```{r}
ce_perspectives_ls <- list(

  Healthcare = c(

    "Healthcare perspective:",
    "Healthcare sector perspective:",
    "Healthcare sector:",
    "Health sector perspective:",
    "Health sector:",
    "Health-care perspective:",
    "Healthcare:"

  ),

  Payer = c(

    "Healthcare payer:",
    "Health-care payer:",
    "Australian Government (third-party payer of healthcare services)"

  ),

  Societal = c(

    "Partial societal perspective:",
    "Societal perspective:",
    "Partial societal:",
    "Societal:",
    "Sococietal:"

  )

)
```

```{r}
processed_tb <- processed_tb  %>%

  transform_to_extract_ce_perspective(

    source_col =
      CE_Item_Text,

    variants_ls =
      ce_perspectives_ls,

    perspective_col =
      "Perspective",

    original_text_col =
      "CE_Item_Text_Original",

    matched_pattern_col =
      "Matched_Perspective"

  )
```

```{r}
nrow(processed_tb)
```

```{r}
processed_tb <- processed_tb  %>%
  transform_to_extract_trailing_text(source_col = CE_Item_Text,
                                     trailing_text_col = "CE_Trailing_Text",
                                     section_patterns_chr = c("Incremental NMB:",
                                                              "ICER - "))
```

```{r}
nrow(processed_tb)
```

```{r}
processed_tb <- processed_tb  %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Has_Secondary_Block =
      !is.na(
        CE_Trailing_Text
      )
  )
```

```{r}
processed_tb <- processed_tb  %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Has_Secondary_Block =
      !is.na(
        CE_Trailing_Text
      )
  )
```


```{r}
processed_tb <- processed_tb  %>%

  transform_to_expand_unnumbered_perspectives(

    source_col =
      CE_Item_Text,

    variants_ls =
      ce_perspectives_ls

  )
```

```{r}
nrow(processed_tb)
```

```{r}
statistic_patterns_ls <- list(

  ICER = c(
    "ICER =",
    "ICER:",
    "ICER - "
  ),

  INMB = c(
    "INMB"
  ),

  NMB = c(
    "Incremental NMB:",
    "NMB ="
  ),

  ROI = c(
    "ROI:"
  )

)


```

```{r}
processed_tb <- processed_tb  %>%

  transform_to_expand_ce_statistics(

    source_col =
      CE_Item_Text,

    statistic_patterns_ls =
      statistic_patterns_ls,

    statistic_col =
      "Statistic_Type",

    statistic_text_col =
      "Statistic_Text",

    original_text_col =
      "Statistic_Source"

  )
```


```{r}
nrow(processed_tb)
```



```{r}
result_dimension_patterns_ls <- list(

  QALY = c(
    "qaly gained",
    "qaly lost"
  ),

  DALY = c(
    "daly averted"
  ),

  K10 = c(
    "point decreased on k10",
    "k10"
  ),

  MADRS = c(
    "madrs point"
  ),

  PSP = c(
    "psp point"
  ),

  RELAPSE = c(
    "relapse case avoided"
  ),

  MDE_DAY = c(
    "mde day averted"
  )

)
```

```{r}
processed_tb <- processed_tb %>%

  transform_to_extract_result_dimensions(

    source_cols = list(

      rlang::sym(
        "CE_Pre_Item_Text"
      ),

      rlang::sym(
        "Statistic_Text"
      ),

      rlang::sym(
        "Outcomes"
      )

    ),

    result_dimension_patterns_ls =
      result_dimension_patterns_ls,

    output_col =
      "Result_Dimensions"

  )
```

```{r}
nrow(processed_tb)
```

```{r}
processed_tb <- processed_tb %>%

  transform_to_expand_result_dimensions(

    source_col =
      Result_Dimensions,

    output_col =
      "Result_Dimension"

  )
```

```{r}
nrow(processed_tb)
```
```{r}
processed_tb <- processed_tb %>%

  dplyr::mutate(

    Multi_Dimension_Result =

      Result_Dimensions %in%

      c(
        "QALY; DALY",
        "QALY; PSP",
        "QALY; RELAPSE",
        "DALY; MDE_DAY"
      )

  )
```

```{r}
processed_tb <- processed_tb %>%

  transform_to_extract_dimension_text(

    source_col =
      Statistic_Text,

    dimension_col =
      "Result_Dimension",

    output_col =
      "Dimension_Text"

  )
```


```{r}
processed_tb <- processed_tb %>%

  transform_to_fill_statistic_type()
```

```{r}
processed_tb %>%

  dplyr::count(
    Statistic_Type,
    Result_Dimension,
    sort = TRUE
  )
```

```{r}
processed_tb <- processed_tb %>%

  dplyr::mutate(

    Result_Dimension =

      dplyr::case_when(

        Statistic_Type == "ROI" ~

          NA_character_,

        TRUE ~

          Result_Dimension

      )

  )
```

```{r}
nrow(processed_tb)
```


```{r}
processed_tb <- processed_tb %>%

  transform_to_extract_result_status(

    source_col =
      Dimension_Text,

    output_col =
      "Result_Status"

  )
```

```{r}
nrow(processed_tb)
```
```{r}
processed_tb <- processed_tb %>%

  transform_to_extract_point_estimate_text(

    source_col =
      Dimension_Text,

    output_col =
      "Point_Estimate_Text"

  )
```



```{r}
processed_tb <- processed_tb %>%

  transform_to_extract_result_value(

    source_col =
      Dimension_Text,

    status_col =
      Result_Status,

    output_col =
      "Result_Value"

  )
```

```{r}
processed_tb <- processed_tb %>%

  dplyr::mutate(

    Has_Multiple_Horizons =

      Paper_id %in%

      c(
        "551",
        "435",
        "431"
      )

  )
```

```{r}
processed_tb <- processed_tb %>%

  transform_to_extract_ci_text(

    source_col =
      Dimension_Text

  )
```

```{r}
processed_tb <- processed_tb %>%

  transform_to_extract_result_status(

    source_col =
      Point_Estimate_Text,

    output_col =
      "Result_Status"

  )
```

```{r}
processed_tb <- processed_tb %>%

  transform_to_extract_result_value(

    source_col =
      Point_Estimate_Text,

    status_col =
      Result_Status,

    output_col =
      "Result_Value",

    scale_col =
      "Result_Value_Scale"

  )
```

```{r}
processed_tb <- processed_tb %>%

  dplyr::mutate(

    Result_Value_Adjusted =

      dplyr::case_when(

        Result_Value_Scale == "million" ~

          Result_Value * 1e6,

        TRUE ~

          Result_Value

      )

  )
```

```{r}
processed_tb <- processed_tb %>%

  transform_to_extract_ci_values()
```

```{r}
processed_tb <- processed_tb %>%

  dplyr::mutate(

    CI_Lower_Value_Adjusted =

      dplyr::case_when(

        CI_Lower_Value_Scale == "million" ~

          CI_Lower_Value * 1e6,

        TRUE ~

          CI_Lower_Value

      ),

    CI_Upper_Value_Adjusted =

      dplyr::case_when(

        CI_Upper_Value_Scale == "million" ~

          CI_Upper_Value * 1e6,

        TRUE ~

          CI_Upper_Value

      )

  )
```
